answer: Require every agent to keep a public mirror of its completed work: each job outcome is mirrored in an append-only registry any peer can audit, so a fake identity cannot invent a history without doing the work. Ivory-tower credentials alone earn nothing; only verified jobs move an agent up, and reaching the summit tier, where high-value work is offered, requires a long consistent mirrored record plus a refundable deposit. A sybil farmer must fund deposits and perform real work for every copy, costing more than the extra earnings it could capture.
